description: Scrape Brazilian packaged-food products from Open Food Facts by keyword, category, brand, store, or barcode. Filter by Nutri-Score, NOVA and Eco-Score.

barcodes.description: EAN-8/EAN-13/UPC codes or Open Food Facts product URLs (mode=byBarcode). One per item.
barcodes.title: Barcodes or product URLs

brandName.description: Brand name, taxonomy tag, or Open Food Facts brand URL. Examples: 'Camil', 'Nestlé', 'Sadia', 'xx:camil'.
brandName.title: Brand (mode=byBrand)

categoryTag.description: Category name, taxonomy tag, or Open Food Facts category URL. Examples: 'cereais', 'biscoitos', 'iogurtes', 'en:rices', 'pt:cereais'.
categoryTag.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

ecoscoreGradeFilter.description: Keep products with this Eco-Score grade or better.
ecoscoreGradeFilter.title: Eco-Score filter

includePrices.description: Fetch the latest Open Prices record (BRL price, date, store and location) for each product. Sparse: prices exist for a small share of products; adds one Open Prices request per 100 products.
includePrices.title: Include Open Prices

maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to return. Values above 10,000 automatically use 41 created-time partitions covering the full Brazilian catalog (~38,700 products).
maxItems.title: Max items

enumTitles: Look up by barcode or product URL
mode.title: Mode

novaGroupFilter.description: Keep only products in this NOVA processing group: 1 = unprocessed, 2 = processed ingredients, 3 = processed, 4 = ultra-processed.
novaGroupFilter.title: NOVA group filter

nutritionGradeFilter.description: Keep products with this Nutri-Score grade or better. Applies to all discovery and barcode modes.
nutritionGradeFilter.title: Nutri-Score filter

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword (all modes). Examples: 'arroz', 'feijão', 'biscoito', 'leite condensado'. Leave empty in browse mode to list products without a keyword.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Result order. 'Best match' uses keyword relevance; browse modes default to most scanned.
sortBy.title: Sort by

storeTag.description: Retail store name, tag, or Open Food Facts store URL. Examples: 'Carrefour', 'Assaí', 'Extra', 'BIG', 'Pão de Açúcar'.
storeTag.title: Store (mode=byStore)

title: Open Food Facts Brazil Scraper Input
